policies.title: Colombian ordinary passports: Bangladesh visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Colombia's current Foreign Ministry table says Colombian tourists may obtain a Bangladesh visa on arrival for 30 days with a return ticket.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Colombian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The table specifies tourism, a 30-day stay and a return ticket.
Final admission and non-visitor travel remain outside scope.

policies.title: Colombian ordinary passports: Central African Republic advance visitor visa

conditions: Applies to an ordinary Colombian passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The source says the route is consular and neither eVisa nor visa on arrival is available.
Work, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
